_comment: Nova's render settings and per-object properties for Solaris (docs/design/M4.md 3.7): the one table gen_nova_ds.py turns into soho/parameters/HdNovaRendererPlugin_{Global,Geometry,Viewport}.ds and build_nova_hdas.py into the Nova Render Settings LOP. scopes: global = a render setting (Render Settings LOP), viewport = also in the viewport's display options, geometry = also a constant primvar per prim (Render Geometry Settings LOP, primvars:<key>). Defaults must equal the delegate's descriptors (hydra/renderDelegate.cpp); tests/houdini/test_solaris_ui.py checks it. hda: false keeps a global setting out of what the Nova LOPs author (it stays on the Nova tab of the Render Settings LOP).

settings.label: Samples
settings.help: Samples per pixel. Unset: Karma's samples (Path Traced: pathtracedsamples; Variance and Distributed: samplesperpixel times varianceaa_maxsamples).

settings.label: Pixel Filter
settings.help: The pixel reconstruction filter. Unset: Karma's pixelfilter.

settings.label: Pixel Filter Scale
settings.help: Multiplies the filter's width (0: point sampling). Unset: Karma's pixelfilterscale.

settings.label: Seed
settings.help: Varies the sample pattern between renders of the same frame. Unset: Karma's randomseed.

settings.label: Clamp Indirect
settings.help: Clamps indirect light per sample against fireflies (0: off). Unset (and Clamp Direct unset): Karma's colour limits (colorlimit for what the camera sees and the first hit gathers, colorlimitindirect for the rest, emission found by the first bounce counting as indirect).

settings.label: Clamp Direct
settings.help: Clamps per sample what the camera sees directly and the light the first hit gathers (0: off).

settings.label: Device
settings.help: Where Nova renders: on the CPU, or on an NVIDIA GPU with OptiX (XPU; the CPU takes over when no GPU is usable). Unset, each renderer uses its own: Nova the CPU, Nova XPU the GPU. The Rendering Engine menu of the Nova LOPs picks the renderer instead.

settings.label: Max Ray Depth
settings.help: A safety cap on the scattering events of a path; the per-type limits decide the look.

settings.label: Diffuse Limit
settings.help: Diffuse bounces (fractions dither between the neighbouring integers). Past the limit, rays only collect light. Unset: Karma's diffuselimit.

settings.label: Reflection Limit
settings.help: Glossy and mirror reflection bounces. Unset: Karma's reflectlimit.

settings.label: Refraction Limit
settings.help: Refraction bounces. Unset: Karma's refractlimit.

settings.label: SSS Limit
settings.help: Subsurface and translucency bounces. Unset: Karma's ssslimit.

settings.label: Volume Limit
settings.help: Volume scattering events. Unset: Karma's volumelimit.

settings.label: Thin Walls at the Refraction Limit
settings.help: Past the refraction limit (up to twice it), refractions continue straight on instead of stopping. Unset: Karma's thinwallatrefractlimit.

settings.label: Fake Caustics
settings.help: Shadows and diffuse rays pass through this object's transmission (transparent shadows) instead of needing caustic paths. Unset: Karma's causticsenable inverted, with Karma's shadow factor and its fake-caustics controls; Karma's render settings fake caustics by default.

settings.label: Caustics Roughness Clamp
settings.help: The least roughness of glossy and refracting surfaces seen after a diffuse bounce (true caustics only): softer, less noisy caustics. Unset: Karma's causticsroughnessclamp (0.2 with Karma's render settings).

settings.label: Internal Reflection
settings.help: Refracting surfaces reflect on their inside too. Off: light inside a solid dielectric leaves it without Fresnel loss and only total internal reflection sends it back in. Unset: Karma's internalreflectenable (off with Karma's render settings).

settings.label: Dielectric Priority
settings.help: Where refracting objects overlap (liquid in a glass, ice in the liquid), the inside belongs to the one with the highest priority: 0 is the highest, larger numbers lose. Surfaces of lower priority inside a higher one are passed through unseen; the others bend light by the ratio of the indices on both sides. Equal priorities nest nothing. Unset: Karma's dielectricpriority.

settings.label: Constrain by Maximum Roughness
settings.help: Glossy surfaces along a path are at least as rough as the roughest glossy bounce before them (fewer fireflies from sharp reflections seen in blurry ones). Unset: Karma's constrainmaxrough (on with Karma's render settings).

settings.label: Efficient Emission Sampling
settings.help: Treats an emissive mesh or volume as a light source: its emission is light-sampled (much less noise on what it lights) and is a light (L) in light path expressions, also for the camera. Yes and Auto both treat the parts whose material emits. Moving meshes and VEX materials stay plain emitters. Unset: Karma's treat_as_lightsource, whose light multipliers (lightsource_diffusescale and specularscale) Nova reads as well.

settings.label: Is Portal
settings.help: The mesh becomes a light portal: it renders nothing, and the dome lights it serves shine only through their portals (light from directions that pass no portal is shut out, as in Karma), sampled through them: much less noise in interiors lit through windows. Cover every opening a dome should light through. Unset: Karma's isportal.

settings.label: Portal Dome Lights
settings.help: The dome lights the portal serves: their paths, separated by spaces, with * and ? wildcards (* serves every dome light). Unset: Karma's portaldomelights.

settings.label: Curve Style
settings.help: How curves render: flat ribbons turned towards each ray, round tubes (normals ignored), ribbons facing their normals, or ribbons where the curves have normals and tubes elsewhere. Linear curves cannot be oriented and face the ray. Unset: Karma's curve_style.

settings.label: Width Scale
settings.help: Multiplies the widths of curves and points. Unset: Karma's width_scale.

settings.label: Point Style
settings.help: How points render: discs turned towards each ray, spheres, or discs facing the points' normals (facing the ray where there are none). Unset: Karma's point_style.

settings.label: Velocity Blur
settings.help: Motion blur of meshes, curves and points from their velocities (v in SOPs, units per second) instead of their time samples, for geometry whose point count changes from frame to frame. Velocity Blur moves the points in straight lines over the shutter; Acceleration Blur bends the paths with the accelerations (accel), sampled Acceleration Samples times. Volumes blur by their velocity field when this is on (both modes move them linearly; Karma's volumevblurscale scales it). Unset: Karma's vblur (on the object, else on the render settings).

settings.label: Instance Velocity Blur
settings.help: Set on a point instancer: its instances move with the instancer's velocities and turn with its angular velocities instead of following the time samples of their positions and orientations; Acceleration Blur adds the accelerations. Unset: Karma's instance_vblur (on the instancer, else on the render settings).

settings.label: Acceleration Samples
settings.help: How many times Acceleration Blur samples the shutter (Max Motion Steps caps it); 2 is a straight line from shutter open to close. Unset: Karma's geosamples, on point instancers its instance_samples.

settings.label: Max Motion Steps
settings.help: The most shutter samples of moving geometry, transforms and cameras.

settings.label: Pixel Oracle
settings.help: Uniform renders Samples in every pixel. Variance stops each pixel once its noise is below the Noise Threshold (adaptive sampling); Samples is then the maximum. Unset: with Karma's samples, Karma's pixel oracle (always Variance in Karma's Variance mode).

settings.label: Minimum Samples
settings.help: Samples every pixel gets before the variance oracle may stop it (rounded up to a power of two). -1: max(16, square root of Samples). Unset: with Karma's samples, from Karma's minrays and varianceaa_minsamples.

settings.label: Noise Threshold
settings.help: The variance oracle's noise level: smaller values render more samples (0.01 is about the quality of 90 uniform samples on a Cornell box). Unset: with Karma's samples, Karma's variance threshold.

settings.label: Denoise
settings.help: Denoises the final frame with the NVIDIA OptiX denoiser (husk, nova_cli): the AOVs of Denoised AOVs, in place. The Karma Render Settings LOP's Denoiser works too. Unset: the denoiser of Karma's image filters.

settings.label: Denoised AOVs
settings.help: The AOVs to denoise (their names, e.g. C directdiffuse); LPE AOVs denoise with the beauty's kernels.

settings.label: Denoise the Viewport
settings.help: Shows the viewport's image denoised by the NVIDIA OptiX denoiser. Unset: Karma's viewport denoise toggle.

settings.label: Denoise Start Passes
settings.help: The viewport shows the noisy image for the first passes after an edit, then the denoised one.

settings.label: IPR Proxy Passes
settings.help: After an edit the viewport first renders one pixel per 4x4, then per 2x2 block, for a fast first image; those samples count towards the image. 0: full passes only. Unset: Karma's ipr_proxydepth.

settings.label: Subdivision Level
settings.help: Uniform subdivision level of subdivision surfaces (-1: from the display complexity).

settings.label: Max Triangles per Mesh
settings.help: Triangle budget of a subdivided or displaced mesh; above it, coarser tessellation and a warning.

settings.label: Dicing Quality Scale
settings.help: Multiplies every object's displacement dicing quality. Unset: Karma's dicingqualityscale.

settings.label: Off-screen Dicing Quality
settings.help: Dicing quality of displaced objects outside the camera's view. Unset: Karma's offscreenquality.

settings.label: Dicing Quality
settings.help: Displacement micropolygons per pixel edge (0.5: 2-pixel micropolygons, Karma's default). Unset: Karma's dicingquality.

settings.label: Dicing Depth
settings.help: A fixed 2^depth segments per edge instead of the camera's rate (-1: off). Unset: Karma's dicingdepthmin and dicingdepthmax when they agree.

settings.label: Displacement
settings.help: Applies the material's displacement. Unset: Karma's truedisplace (off for Disable Displacement Shader).

settings.label: Convert Textures
settings.help: Converts images to tiled, MIP-mapped, linear .tx files in the texture cache directory.

settings.label: Texture Cache Directory
settings.help: Where converted textures go (empty: $HOUDINI_TEMP_DIR/nova_tx).

settings.label: Texture Blur
settings.help: Extra blur of every texture lookup. Unset: Karma's mtlx_imageblur.

settings.label: Texture Filter Width
settings.help: Texture footprint relative to the pixel's ray cone (0.25 as Karma; 0: the finest MIP level). Unset: a quarter of Karma's mtlx_imagewidth.

settings.label: Abort on Missing Texture
settings.help: Stops the render when a texture file cannot be read. Unset: Karma's abortmissingtexture.

settings.label: Texture Statistics
settings.help: OpenImageIO texture statistics level printed at the end of a render.

settings.label: GPU Texture Budget
settings.help: The GPU memory for textures with Nova XPU, in MB (0: half the memory free when the first texture loads). When the textures do not fit, the largest are reduced first: every texture is capped at the largest size that fits (all tiles of a UDIM set alike) and only the MIP levels kept are read, with a warning.

settings.label: Light Selection
settings.help: How a light sample picks its light: the light tree weighs every light by how much it can light the point (scenes with many lights render with far less noise); Uniform picks by power alone. Unset: Karma's light_sampling_mode.

settings.label: Light Sampling
settings.help: Debugging aid: which estimators sample direct light.
